mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher_info WHERE status=1 AND deleted=0) AS `teacherCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_info WHERE status=1 AND deleted=0) AS `studentCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mental_response mr JOIN student_info s ON s.id=mr.student_id AND s.deleted=0 JOIN mental_questionnaire q ON q.id=mr.questionnaire_id AND q.deleted=0 WHERE mr.create_time >= #{startTime} AND mr.create_time < #{endTime}) AS `todayCompletionCount`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ma.student_id) FROM mental_assessment ma JOIN student_info s ON s.id=ma.student_id AND s.deleted=0 WHERE ma.level IN ('中度','重度','高危') AND ma.warning_status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS')) AS `warningCount`
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS `day`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM teacher_info WHERE deleted=0 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY `day`
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS `day`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM student_info WHERE deleted=0 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY `day`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS count FROM teacher_info WHERE deleted=0 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY ym

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS count FROM student_info WHERE deleted=0 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY ym
SELECT '教师' AS name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM teacher_info WHERE deleted=0 AND status=1 UNION ALL SELECT '学生' AS name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM student_info WHERE deleted=0 AND status=1
SELECT username,role,ip,DATE_FORMAT(login_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS time FROM sys_login_log WHERE status=1 ORDER BY login_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'MENTAL_WARNING' AS kind,ma.id AS source_id,ma.student_id, '心理预警待跟进' AS title,ma.warning_status AS status,ma.level,ma.create_time AS event_time FROM mental_assessment ma JOIN student_info s ON s.id=ma.student_id WHERE UNION ALL SELECT 'AGENT_EXCEPTION' AS kind,a.id AS source_id,a.student_id, CASE WHEN a.status='REJECTED' THEN 'Agent 审核拒绝，需人工复核' ELSE 'Agent 任务失败，需检查' END AS title, a.status,NULL AS level,TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,8,a.updated_at) AS event_time FROM agent_task a JOIN student_info s ON s.id=a.student_id WHERE ) pending_sources ORDER BY event_time DESC,kind,source_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'teacher' AS type,id,name,employee_id AS code,dept_name FROM teacher_info WHERE deleted=0 AND (LOCATE(#{query},name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{query},employee_id)>0) UNION ALL SELECT 'student' AS type,id,name,student_id AS code,dept_name FROM student_info WHERE deleted=0 AND (LOCATE(#{query},name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{query},student_id)>0) ) directory ORDER BY type,name,id LIMIT #{limit}
